cards.mood: The piece opens with a hazy, suspended atmosphere that feels introspective and weightless.
cards.vocal: A single female vocalist delivers the performance with a soft, breathy, and ethereal timbre.
cards.palette: A clean electric guitar, treated with significant delay and reverb, plays a repetitive, arpeggiated motif that serves as the central melodic hook from the introduction through to the outro.

lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Silver dust dances in the hall
Shadows stretch long against the wall
The moon hangs like a heavy pearl
Where the quiet edges start to curl
[Pre-Chorus]
Floating in a velvet sea
Weightless as the wind is free
[Chorus]
Lose the ground beneath your feet
Where the earth and velvet meet
Drifting through a pale blue haze
Lost inside the golden maze
[Verse]
Petals fall in slow-motion grace
Time becomes a soft and steady pace
Water flows like silk across the stone
In the garden where the seeds were sown
[Pre-Chorus]
Every breath is soft and deep
Promises that the echoes keep
[Chorus]
Lose the ground beneath your feet
Where the earth and velvet meet
Drifting through a pale blue haze
Lost inside the golden maze
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
A spark of light within the gray
Watching as the colors melt away
[Chorus]
Lose the ground beneath your feet
Where the earth and velvet meet
Drifting through a pale blue haze
Lost inside the golden maze
[Outro]
